prerequisites: Prior knowledge of basic concepts regarding the general laws of rigid solid mechanics and their subsequent application to solving engineering problems is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Identify and quantify the different types of forces, stresses, and deformations.
Dimension and verify simple mechanical elements.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts about Elasticity. Failure criteria
Simple stresses: stresses, deformations and diagrams
Combined stresses: stresses, deformations and diagrams

assessment_methods.method: Written face-to-face exam (Continuous Evaluation, Ordinary Call)
Continuous Evaluation (PLs and Controls) (Continuous Evaluation, Ordinary Call)
Written face-to-face exam (Continuous Evaluation, Extraordinary Calls)
Half of Continuous Evaluation Grade (PLs, Controls) (Continuous Evaluation, Extraordinary Calls)

assessment_rules: For Continuous Evaluation in the Ordinary Call, the final grade is calculated as 0.80 * Exam_Grade (out of 10) + Continuous_Evaluation. Continuous Evaluation is composed of 0.5 points from PLs (0.1 x 5 PLs) and two short theoretical-practical controls (2 x 0.75). For Extraordinary Calls with Continuous Evaluation, the final grade is 0.90 * Exam_Grade (out of 10) + 0.50 * Continuous_Evaluation, where half of the continuous evaluation grade is considered. Differentiated Evaluation consists solely of a 100% written face-to-face theoretical-practical exam.
